The name Mubaraq carries the meaning “Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubaraq usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: مبارق
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبارق هو اسم مشتق من كلمة مبارك، ويعني المبارك، الموفق للخير، المثمر للخيرات. يعود أصل هذا الاسم إلى الجذر اللغوي (ب-ر-ك) الذي يحمل معاني البركة والخير والنماء. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: {وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلم} [الإسراء: 73]، وقد وردت كلمة مبارك في الحديث النبوي الشريف: «مبارك هو الذي يبارك الله على يديه».

in_urdu.name: مبارق
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبارق ایک ایسا نام ہے جو مبارک سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے مبارک، موفق للخیر، مبارکباد۔ اس کا اصل عربی جڑ (ب-ر-ك) ہے، جو برکت، خیر اور نمو کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن مجید میں کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جن میں سے ایک یہ ہے: {وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلم} [الإسراء: 73]. اور یہ لفظ حدیث نبوی شریف میں بھی آیا ہے: «مبارك هو الذي يبارك الله على يديه».

in_hindi.name: मुबारक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबारक एक नाम है जो मुबारक से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मुबारक, मोबाश्शिर खैर, आशीर्वादित। इसकी जड़ अरबी भाषा में है (ب-ر-ك), जिसका अर्थ है बरकत, खैर और विकास। यह शब्द कुरआन में कई जगहों पर आया है, जैसे कि: {وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلم} [الإسراء: 73]. यह शब्द पैगंबर मुहम्मद के वाक्य में भी आया है: «मुबारक वह है जिस पर अल्लाह अपने हाथों से बरकत करता है».

in_pashto.name: مبارق
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبارق د مبارک څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې معنی یې مبارک، برکت لرونکی، نیکمرغه ده. د دې کلمې اصل عربي ژبه کې دى (ب-ر-ك)، چې د برکت، خير او ودې معنی لري. دا کلمه په قرآن کريم کې په ډېرو ځايونو کې راغلې ده، لکه: {وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلم} [الإسراء: 73]. او دا کلمه د پېغمبر محمد حدیث شريف کې هم راغلې ده: «مبارك هو الذي يبارك الله على يديه».

in_english.name: Mubaraq
in_english.meaning: Blessed, fortunate, one who brings good fortune
in_english.long_meaning: Mubaraq is an Arabic name derived from the root (ب-ر-ك), which carries meanings of blessing, goodness, and growth. The name signifies blessed, fortunate, or one who brings good fortune. It appears in the Quran in several verses, including: {وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلم} [الإسراء: 73]. The name Mubaraq also appears in the prophetic tradition: 'Mubarak is he on whose hands Allah bestows blessings.' The name conveys spiritual significance, implying a person who is a source of blessings and good fortune.

The name is often given as a wish for a child to bring good fortune and prosperity into the family. Gifts are exchanged, feasts are prepared, and special prayers are offered to celebrate the birth of a child named Mubaraq.

It is a constant source of inspiration and motivation for the child to strive towards spiritual growth and seek Allah's blessings in every aspect of their life. Additionally, the name Mubaraq is a reminder of the significance of seeking blessing and gratitude from Allah in all circumstances, as encouraged in the Islamic faith.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, Volume 11, Page 141. Ibn Kathir describes Mubarak ibn Muqarrin as the 'Imam of the Zanji Turks' who ruled parts of Persia and Iraq during the Abbasid Caliphate in the late 9th and early 10th centuries. He was known for his military prowess and for expanding the territory of the Zanji Empire.

Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, Volume 1, Page 255. Ibn Khaldun mentions Mubarak ibn Muqarrin as the founder of the Zanji Empire and describes him as a brave and skilled military leader who was able to conquer large parts of the Islamic world, including Iraq and Syria, in the early 10th century.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic name 'Mubaraq' is commonly used as a well-wishing term in various contexts, particularly during special occasions such as the birth of a child. Its usage has significantly increased in the modern world, with three popular platforms being Social Media, Mobile Applications, and WhatsApp. On these platforms, users often share messages, images, and videos of newborns and use the term 'Mubaraq' to express their blessings and wishes for the child's happiness, success, and good health.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Mubaraq in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Mubaraq, which means "Blessed". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
